beats.say: Today DENICE crashes when it closes if a page played sound to a speaker it picked itself. The fix is one more Chromium switch in DENICE's existing startup class, Application.
Application already exists. It's DENICE's private CEF class in the macOS project. Only one method changes.
This method lists Chromium's switches before CEF starts: single-process, in-process GPU, no GPU sandbox, mock keychain. The proposal adds disable-features AudioServiceOutOfProcess in every build.
The page calls the method private. In C# it is protected override. The language has no word for that, so the label is wrong but the design is the same.
Take a page that plays to a device it picked, then you close DENICE. Single-process already puts Chromium's audio service inside DENICE's process.

Today, one Chromium check ignores single-process and creates a device watcher inside that service. At close, the browser's device monitor is deleted first. Then the watcher tries to unregister from it, and the process crashes with exit 139.
With the switch, Chromium watches devices through the browser's own monitor and never creates that watcher. The sound plays the same, and DENICE closes with exit 0.
Without the switch, three stock runs and the experiment run all crashed at the same place. With it, the stock build and the experiment build both closed cleanly after the same script.

Not tested: Apple Silicon, devices plugged in or out during a session, and any other Chromium use of this feature. The page can't check those, and neither can the check that passed it. That check only proves the document is valid, not that the code matches it.

Separately, nobody has heard the experiment's playback yet. The check takes 20 seconds: one quiet tone, then the words listening check, from the default speaker. It uses only the default output, so this crash shouldn't affect it. Will you run it?

One correction to earlier results. No leading samples lost is exact only for AudioContext sounds. Audio and video elements fade in their first 240 samples, so every sample is there but the first ones are quieter.
